Hi Lisa,

Thanks again for the intro call last week — great to hear more about Greenfield's upcoming search-and-personalization roadmap. We'd like to schedule a 45-minute demo to walk through the Redwood Inference platform, focused on latency/cost tradeoffs, model routing, and our Dedicated/Private deployment options.

Proposed slot:
- Wed Nov 10, 2026 — 09:00–09:45 PT (45m)

Planned attendees from our side: myself (product lead), Karthik Iyer (solutions engineer), and Marissa Cole (customer success). If that time works, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short demo deck. If any additional stakeholders should attend (security, procurement, infra), let me know and we can expand the agenda.

A few prep notes:
- If you have a short PoV checklist or procurement requirements, please share and we’ll incorporate.
- We can extend to 60–75 minutes if you need a deeper technical walkthrough.

Cheers,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: (415) 555-0142

- Tue Nov 16 — 10:30–11:30 PT (60m)
- Thu Nov 18 — 13:00–14:15 PT (75m)

Draft agenda if we take the 75m slot (can be shortened):
1) 5m — intros and goals (your team)
2) 25m — platform demo: routing, cost/latency controls, Dedicated vs Hosted
3) 15m — security & integration deep-dive (KV/cache, SSO, encryption)
4) 15m — procurement & pricing example, next steps (PO/contract anchors)
5) 15m — Q&A / follow-up items

Soojin from our security team will also join depending on the agenda items — adding her to the thread so she can confirm the sections she should cover. Karthik will run the demo.

We have a short updated demo outline attached that maps to your PoV checklist. Can you confirm which of the two slots you prefer and the attendee list (names + roles) so we can send an invite? Also, would your security team be able to fill out the SSO questionnaire ahead of the call? (link below)

SSO/security questionnaire: https://redwood.in/docs/sso-questionnaire

Thanks — I’ll hold both times tentatively until I hear back.

Looping in with a quick note from security:

Thanks for the heads-up. For the security/integration portion, please plan for the following so Darren & his team can get their answers:
- 10m: Data-in-transit and data-at-rest encryption overview (certs/KMS options)
- 15m: Threat model and isolation (VCs, tenant isolation, dedicated capacity controls)
- 10m: Audit logs, retention, and data access controls (SOC 2 pointers)

If Greenfield needs SOC2 artifacts in advance, we can share a SOC2 summary and redacted report under an NDA — procurement often requests that up front. If the main demo is the right forum, I prefer Thu Nov 18 for the full 75m so we have enough time to cover technical questions without rushing.

Also recommend a 20–30m pre-demo drop-in for Anjali (Platform) + Karthik if their timeline includes a deeper infra mapping — we can do that the day before if helpful.

— Soojin
